title: base process schema
description: Mirror of workflow/base: properties (the names of what the run yields) carries over; units become steps grouped into stages; the application a workflow names becomes the instrument each stage runs on; the samples consumed and produced are what a physical process adds.

categories.description: Technique this process applies. A measurement protocol is a process with characterization categories, which is why both branches are allowed here.

properties.description: Array of characteristic properties produced by this process, by name, e.g. film_thickness

stages.description: Ordered stages, the analogue of workflow.subworkflows. A stage is the level that binds a technique and an instrument, because a run can move between chambers.

_inputSamples.description: Subsets of the full information about the samples consumed, e.g. the substrates loaded into the chamber.

_outputSamples.description: Subsets of the full information about the samples produced or modified by the run.

identifiers.description: Identifiers this run carries in other systems, e.g. a lab-system run number.

logFiles.description: Tool logs this record was derived from.
